history.summary: THIS IS A JAIN TEMPLE, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. A Digambar Jain temple dedicated to Lord Adinath (Rishabhdev, the first Tirthankara), located at Mugalli near Rosery Chapel on Davorlim Road, Margao. It is described as one of the two Digambar Jain temples in Goa state. The temple has a dharmshala (guest house) with a bhojnalaya serving Jain food; dhoti-dupatta are provided for abhishek, and daily abhishek starts at 7:30 AM. No web source documents its founding history or builders — the founding date is unverified. CSV town (Margao) is approximately correct: the temple is in the Davorlim/Mugalli area on the outskirts of Margao.

town_description: Margao (Madgaon) is the largest city of South Goa and its commercial capital, set along the Sal river near the coast. A historic trading town with Portuguese-era churches, markets and old houses, it was also a pre-Portuguese temple city — the Damodar deity now at Zambaulim originated here. It is the gateway to South Goa's beaches and the Konkan railway's main Madgaon station.

travel.road: On Davorlim Road near Rosery Chapel, Mugalli, Margao (Goa 403601); reachable by taxi or bus from Margao city centre
